findings.title: Hard-tier structural firewall is not universally implemented on graph writes.
findings.details: The backend claim verifier can reject unsupported claims, but the documented structural validators and synthesis gate are absent. Direct graph writes and promotions do not call a firewall.

findings.title: Review queue specified by architecture bible is missing.
findings.details: The code has graph/staged and approval, but not users/{uid}/situations/{caseId}/review-queue/ nor firewall-mediated promotion from review.

findings.title: Synthesized labels and caps are contracts, not runtime gates.
findings.details: Types and skill docs mention synthesized metadata and low-confidence caps, but no runtime output schemas or synthesis gate were found.

findings.title: Route-level firewall audit is too shallow for write-path coverage.
findings.details: audit:firewall-coverage checks marker strings and passes, but misses graph-populate, backend pipeline, Neo4j merge, and in-memory graph ingestion paths.

findings.title: Sibling worktree lacks local node_modules.
findings.details: npm run fails with tsx not recognized in this assigned worktree. Installed binaries from C:\Users\giuli\praxiscodexworking were usable for tsx audits; Vitest remained blocked because vitest/config was resolved relative to this worktree.

overall.summary: Soft-tier advisory/nonblocking behavior and backend claim rejection tests are real. Hard-tier structural write coverage, synthesized runtime enforcement, and review-queue promotion are not sufficiently implemented for the architecture bible section 6 target.
recommended_next_audit_targets: Add a non-mutating static audit that enumerates every graph write function/route and requires a structural firewall call.
Add emulator-backed synthetic write tests for reject, advise, review-queue, and promotion flows.
Implement or explicitly defer src/lib/firewall/structural.ts, backend/firewall/structural.py, backend/firewall/synthesis_gate.py, ontology relation validators, and review-queue routes.
